verdict.rationale: TruffleHog is documented only as a secrets-scanning tool: it finds, classifies, and verifies credentials in code and other sources. Nothing in the pack shows static analysis for vulnerability classes like injection or XSS. Its custom regex detectors exist to detect secrets, so they are an adjacent feature and earn no credit for SAST rules.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run static analysis that finds vulnerability classes like injection and XSS in my source code
